Exercise Lead Specialist - Programma GCAP
postings.description:
Job Description:
Leonardo è un gruppo industriale internazionale, tra le principali realtà mondiali nell’Aerospazio, Difesa e Sicurezza che realizza capacità tecnologiche multidominio in ambito Elicotteri, Velivoli, Aerostrutture, Elettronica, Cyber Security e Spazio. Con oltre 60.000 dipendenti nel mondo, l’azienda ha una solida presenza industriale in Italia, Regno Unito, Polonia, Stati Uniti, e opera in 150 paesi anche attraverso aziende controllate, joint venture e partecipazioni. Protagonista dei principali programmi strategici a livello globale, è partner tecnologico e industriale di Governi, Amministrazioni della Difesa, Istituzioni e imprese.

Leonardo è uno dei partner industriali strategici del programma GCAP (Global Combat Air Programme), insieme alla britannica BAE Systems e alla giapponese Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, finalizzato allo sviluppo e alla realizzazione di un sistema aereo di nuova generazione, definito come “sistema di sistemi”. Impiegato per operazioni multidominio in ambito difesa, il sistema sarà caratterizzato da una “core platform” connessa con altri sistemi periferici “adjuncts”, pilotati e non pilotati.
Il programma, tra i più sfidanti e avveniristici per l’industria dell’aerospazio e della difesa, guiderà la rivoluzione tecnologica che caratterizzerà il settore nei prossimi cinquant’anni. Una sfida finalizzata a rafforzare la sovranità tecnologica e industriale dei paesi coinvolti, perché punta a identificare e a rendere disponibili quelle tecnologie innovative, dette abilitanti, che assicureranno il salto generazionale, generando ritorni positivi e progresso economico e sociale per l’intero sistema Paese, a beneficio delle nuove generazioni.
Le risorse che lavoreranno all’interno di questo programma avranno l’opportunità di accedere ad un percorso di crescita professionale in un contesto internazionale e tecnologicamente avanzato.

Nell’ambito della Joint Venture costituita per la realizzazione del Programma GCAP, ricerchiamo la figura di Exercise Lead Specialist per il Quartier Generale GCAP sito a Reading (UK).
IL RUOLO PRECEDE UN DISTACCO IN UK PER UN PERIODO MINIMO DI 3 ANNI

OBIETTIVO DELL’INCARICO:
L’Exercise Lead Specialist supporta la pianificazione, l’esecuzione e il miglioramento continuo delle attività di valutazione di sicurezza avverse all’interno dell’organizzazione. Il ruolo affianca l’Exercise Manager nella progettazione di scenari realistici di emulazione delle minacce e garantisce che le operazioni di red team producano evidenze e insight significativi, in grado di rafforzare la postura difensiva dell’azienda.

Il candidato ideale combina competenze tecniche, visione strategica, rigore operativo e solide capacità comunicative.

RESPONSABILITA’:
La risorsa farà parte della funzione di Operations per la JV e a diretto riporto dell’Exercise Manager.

COMPITI:
Pianificazione ed Esecuzione delle Esercitazioni
- Supportare le operazioni di red team end-to-end, incluse attività di ricognizione, threat modelling, progettazione degli scenari e analisi post-esercitazione.

- Collaborare con blue team, purple team e stakeholder rilevanti (ad es. Thames Valley Police) per garantire un’esecuzione sicura, controllata ed efficace.

- Supportare la sicurezza operativa, la gestione del rischio e i processi di deconfliction durante le esercitazioni.

Reporting e Comunicazione
- Redigere report chiari e operativi, traducendo i risultati tecnici in insight rilevanti per il business.

- Presentare i risultati al senior management, includendo valutazioni del rischio e strategie di remediation raccomandate, compreso il rafforzamento della sicurezza dei sistemi ove opportuno.

- Collaborare con i team difensivi per validare eventuali lacune nei meccanismi di rilevazione e supportare i cicli di miglioramento del purple team.

Governance e Compliance
- Garantire che tutte le attività di red team siano conformi alle linee guida legali, etiche e organizzative.

- Mantenere documentazione, autorizzazioni e tracciabilità (audit trail) per tutte le esercitazioni.

- Contribuire, quando necessario, alla preparazione alla risposta agli incidenti e alle esercitazioni tabletop.

Indicatori di Successo
- Esercitazioni di red team in grado di mettere realmente alla prova l’organizzazione e di individuare vulnerabilità concrete e realistiche.

- Solide collaborazioni con i team difensivi che si traducano in miglioramenti misurabili nelle capacità di rilevazione e risposta.

REQUISITI:
Titolo di Studio in linea con le attività previste dal ruolo
- Certificazioni quali Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) Red Teaming (GRT) o equivalenti.

- Esperienza in threat intelligence, incident response o attività di purple teaming.

- Familiarità con controlli di sicurezza enterprise, sistemi SIEM, strumenti EDR e detection engineering.

- Esperienza in settori regolamentati o in ambienti enterprise di grandi dimensioni.

Conoscenze e Competenze Tecniche e Soft:
Requisiti Essenziali:
- Solide capacità di stakeholder management, con comprovata esperienza nella comunicazione con il senior management in diverse funzioni, sia interne sia esterne.

- Capacità di prendere decisioni pragmatiche e di operare in stretta collaborazione con il business.

- Comprovate competenze di problem solving (pensiero prospettico e laterale) applicate a problematiche complesse.

- Capacità di gestire in autonomia le proprie aree di responsabilità all’interno di un progetto, con piena consapevolezza delle responsabilità individuali.

Requisiti Preferenziali:
- Approccio analitico, strutturato e orientato al dettaglio.

- Discrezione e affidabilità, con forte capacità di giudizio nella gestione di informazioni sensibili.

Le risorse che lavoreranno all’interno di questo programma avranno l’opportunità di accedere ad un percorso di crescita professionale in un contesto internazionale e tecnologicamente avanzato.

Il team di Global Security Operations Coordination rappresenta il “tessuto connettivo” che assicura il corretto funzionamento delle operazioni di sicurezza a livello mondiale. Questo ruolo è ideale per chi eccelle nel coordinamento, nella comunicazione e nella disciplina operativa - la persona che garantisce che nulla venga trascurato attraverso fusi orari, team e scenari di minaccia differenti.
Il ruolo supporta il funzionamento quotidiano delle operazioni globali di sicurezza dell’organizzazione, contribuendo al coordinamento delle attività tra i team regionali, mantenendo la consapevolezza del contesto operativo, supportando la gestione degli incidenti e assicurando che i processi operativi funzionino in modo efficiente. Agisce come hub centrale per comunicazione, reporting e gestione delle attività, aiutando la funzione globale di sicurezza a rimanere allineata, informata e pronta a rispondere.

RESPONSABILITA’:
La risorsa farà parte della funzione di Operations per la JV e a diretto riporto del Global Operations Coordination Lead Specialist.

COMPITI:
Coordinamento Operativo
- Supportare i team di sicurezza operativa di Edgewing e le attività quotidiane di sicurezza in UK, Giappone e Italia.

- Supportare la gestione di attività, aggiornamenti e flussi di lavoro tra i team di sicurezza regionali.

- Gestire calendari operativi, pianificazioni dei turni e strumenti di monitoraggio delle attività chiave.

- Garantire il follow-up tempestivo di azioni, escalation e dipendenze tra team.

Supporto alla Gestione e Risposta agli Incidenti
- Supportare il monitoraggio, la documentazione e la comunicazione durante eventi di sicurezza.

- Facilitare il flusso informativo tra team interni, leadership e partner esterni.

- Mantenere registri degli incidenti, report post-evento (after action report) e modelli di reporting.

- Supportare attività di preparazione quali esercitazioni, simulazioni e pianificazione di scenari.

Situational Awareness e Reporting
- Monitorare eventi globali, allerte e flussi informativi per garantire un adeguato livello di consapevolezza situazionale.

- Supportare la predisposizione di report e sintesi giornalieri, settimanali e ad hoc per il management.

- Aggiornare dashboard, metriche e indicatori di performance operativa.

- Assicurare che le informazioni siano accurate, tempestive e coerenti con le esigenze organizzative.

Supporto ai Processi e Governance
- Mantenere e aggiornare procedure operative standard (SOP), playbook e repository documentali.

- Supportare la conformità a policy interne, requisiti di audit e standard qualitativi.

- Contribuire all’onboarding di nuovi membri del team, garantendo coerenza nelle pratiche operative.

- Identificare opportunità di semplificazione dei processi e miglioramento dell’efficienza operativa.

Coinvolgimento degli Stakeholder
- Agire come punto di contatto centrale per team interni e partner esterni in ambito sicurezza.

- Facilitare la comunicazione interfunzionale tra sicurezza, facilities, HR, IT e altre funzioni aziendali.

- Supportare il coordinamento in occasione di visite executive, viaggi ad alto rischio o eventi speciali.

- Costruire relazioni solide con team globali per garantire allineamento e fluidità operativa.

REQUISITI:

Conoscenze e Competenze Tecniche:
- Esperienza in ambito sicurezza operativa, gestione delle emergenze, ruoli di coordinamento o contesti analoghi.

- Spiccate capacità organizzative e di gestione simultanea di più priorità.

- Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale (inglese a livello operativo).

postings.title: Import Export Controller
postings.description:
Job Description:
Salary Range: £38,000 - £48,000

Leonardo UK operates a grade-based salary framework with broad bands. The salary range shown reflects the approved grade band for this role, or a narrower hiring range published within that band, and is benchmarked against the external market. Exceptions above the standard range are managed through governance controls to protect internal equity.

Your Impact

At Leonardo UK, we deliver advanced technologies that help keep people and nations safe. Across the UK, our teams design, develop and support a diverse range of innovative aerospace, defence and security solutions — from airborne radar and targeting systems to infrared detectors, camera systems, cyber and physical security technologies, and rotary aircraft used for commercial, public utility and defence applications.

We are currently seeking a Import/Export Controller to join the team at our Edinburgh site. In this role, you will support the Import/Export function by coordinating customs instructions, maintaining accurate records and assisting with reporting and audit preparation. Working closely with internal stakeholders, freight agents and customs brokers, you will help ensure that import and export activities are conducted in line with UK customs requirements and Leonardo procedures.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their knowledge of trade compliance and international logistics within a collaborative team environment at the heart of a global aerospace and defence organisation.

This is a Hybrid role is based at our Edinburgh site and will requires on site attendance at the Edinburgh site.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Submission of Import and Export customs instructions to agents in accordance with UK customs regulations and company procedures to facilitate customs declarations, including:
- Ensuring that the correct export licences are applied to outgoing shipments and that records for export licence usage are correctly maintained on the company systems.
- Liaising with business to ensure correct and accurate clearance instructions can be issued to agent/import broker
- Instructing freight agent/ broker in accordance with business requirements
- Checking clearance information provided by agent/broker to ensure Leonardo instructions have been followed
- Checking customs entries following goods departure and address anomalies (with reference to site Trade Compliance lead)
- Addressing any anomalies identified (with reference to site Trade Compliance lead)
- Notifying business of import clearance conditions
- Develop an understanding of the Customs Declaration Service (CDS)
- Preparation of data packs relating to import and export transactions in readiness for internal and external audits, ensuring packs are recorded on company systems in accordance with company procedures
- Assisting with the preparation of reports for submission to UK authorities (such as Deferment reports and export licence transparency reports)
- Assisting with processing and reconciling Freight Forwarder invoices

What you'll bring
- Experience supporting multiple stakeholders or customers, with the ability to prioritise workload and manage competing demands effectively
- A self-motivated approach with high personal work standards and strong attention to detail
- The ability to work collaboratively as part of a team, demonstrating supportive and cooperative behaviours
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills, enabling you to work effectively with colleagues and external stakeholders
- Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook and solid working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Word, PowerPoint and Excel
- A high level of professionalism, with the confidence to interact with senior managers and external organisations
- The ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and integrity
- A keen willingness to learn and develop knowledge in import/export processes and trade compliance within Leonardo UK

This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.

Security Clearance
This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV). For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting

Why join us
At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.
- Time to Recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year.
- Secure your Future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution.
- Your Wellbeing Matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity (Enable, Pride, Equalise, Armed Forces, Carers, Wellbeing and Ethnicity).
- Rewarding Performance: All employees at management level and below are eligible for our bonus scheme.
- Never Stop Learning: Free access to 4,000+ online courses via Coursera and LinkedIn Learning.
- Refer a friend: Receive a financial reward through our referral programme.
- Tailored Perks: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more.
- Flexible working: Flexible hours with hybrid working options. For part time opportunities, please talk to us about what might be possible for this role.

For a full list of our company benefits please visit our website.
Leonardo is a global leader in Aerospace, Defence, and Security. Headquartered in Italy, we employ over 53,000 people worldwide including 8,500 across 9 sites in the UK. Our employees are not just part of a team—they are key contributors to shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.

At Leonardo we are committed to building an inclusive, accessible, and welcoming workplace. We believe that a diverse workforce sparks creativity, drives innovation, and leads to better outcomes for our people and our customers. If you have any accessibility requirements to support you during the recruitment process, just let us know.

postings.title: Lead Manufacturing Engineering Specialist
postings.description:
Job Description:
Salary: £59,400- 68,500

Leonardo UK operates a grade-based salary framework with broad bands. The salary range shown reflects the approved grade band for this role, or a narrower hiring range published within that band, and is benchmarked against the external market. Exceptions above the standard range are managed through governance controls to protect internal equity.

Your impact

Leonardo’s Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP) programme represents one of the most significant next‑generation defence avionics developments in Europe. This is a rare career‑defining opportunity to step into a pivotal national technical leadership role, at the heart of a world‑class engineering organisation with decades of expertise.
Lead Manufacturing Engineering Specialists are responsible for developing robust solutions and having broad experience across a number of the lifecycle phases and must be able to demonstrate a 'through life approach’ to manufacturing engineering. Lead Manufacturing Engineering Specialist are expected to achieve objectives across longer term planning horizons and provide complex technical advice to both internal and external customers.
As a Lead Manufacturing Engineering Specialist you will join the team to develop the operations manufacturing requirements of the future, taking innovative processes and equipment into account, enabling world class production of future Leonardo products.
This role will require travel to other sites such as Edinburgh, Basildon and Southampton, with an opportunity to work from home on occasion.

What you will do;
- Provide specialist input including the application of specialist skills and knowledge into a project team to help ensure the delivery of a technically sound solution meeting all stakeholder requirements

- Lead and deliver Manufacturing Engineering sections of the Manufacturing Maturity Reviews, maintain governance through the Lifecycle Management process and create / contribute / review and/or lead Manufacturing Plans, contributing to design and phase reviews, including demonstrating Manufacturing Readiness Level reviews

- Track external developments and disruptive technologies to identify exploitation and knowledge sharing within the project team

- Enable the future development of innovative manufacturing and testing processes for the EW domain by studying product requirements (including new materials), product/process/handling lessons learned, researching and exploring manufacturing methods and equipment; understanding feedback from internal stakeholders, conferring with equipment vendors or external suppliers

- Ensure manufacturing and test decision-making information is robust with objectives and results through preparing product and process reports by collecting, analysing, and summarizing information and trends

- Assure product and process quality by designing methods; validation/verification of process capabilities; establishing standards; confirming manufacturing processes

- Create a culture which improves manufacturing efficiency by generating innovative ideas and solutions developing into infrastructure, cyber security, physical security requirements for the factory of the future developing into capacity analysis, simulation planning workflow, space requirements, and equipment layout

- Take the above and developing manufacturing and test requirements for future designs, collaborating with engineering to influence concepts in preparation for the design and development stage

- Advise and participate on improving policies and processes within the operations framework

- Promote a culture of best practice sharing and knowledge exploitation

- Mentor, coach and develop more junior members of the team in order to develop overall capability

- Provide domain experience in support of customer and user engagement and product road maps

- Maintain product and company reputation by complying with government regulations

What you’ll bring
External Approvals (may include)
- Registration as an Chartered Engineer or other relevant Professional Body

Knowledge, Skills & Experience
- In depth understanding of manufacturing and test processes and principles

- Ability to influence and negotiate with others using data and analysis to support line of reasoning

- A detailed understanding of the operational framework and business processes

- An understanding of cross functional / commercial business processes and their own impact

- Demonstrated knowledge, and experience of multiple phases of the Product Life Cycle and the associated processes

- Experience of peer reviewing the work of others inside a product team and within a sub Engineering Unit and ensuring the resulting actions are implemented

- Ability to communicate concepts in a non-technical way

- Confidence and ability to challenge / respond to technical / process issues whilst understanding the broad impact of solutions (systems thinking)

- Ability to interact effectively and manage the relationships with customers and suppliers

- Been involved in capability and / or process development, demonstrating an ability to implement a change to working practices

Qualifications
- HND or above in an engineering related discipline

This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.

Security Clearance
This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV). For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting
Why join us
At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.
- Time to Recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year.

- Secure your Future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution.

- Your Wellbeing Matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity (Enable, Pride, Equalise, Armed Forces, Carers, Wellbeing and Ethnicity).

- Rewarding Performance: All employees at management level and below are eligible for our bonus scheme.

- Never Stop Learning: Free access to 4,000+ online courses via Coursera and LinkedIn Learning.

- Refer a friend: Receive a financial reward through our referral programme.

- Tailored Perks: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more.

- Flexible working: Flexible hours with hybrid working options. For part time opportunities, please talk to us about what might be possible for this role.

postings.title: Lead Systems Engineer (DA) Land CEMA
postings.description:
Job Description:
Leonardo has an exciting opportunity for a Lead Systems Engineer / Design Authority with experience across the whole of the engineering lifecycle. As Lead Systems Engineer and Design Authority, you will be responsible for providing the technical oversight and expertise at all levels of the overall system solution, working with both internal and supplier design teams to ensure that the architecture of the overall system solution is developed and delivered to meet the Customer, User and business requirements.
Hybrid working at our dedicated site in Basildon, Essex.

Your impact
Working within our Crenic project team, delivering life-saving protection for the UK military within our Land Cyber & Electromagnetic Activities (CEMA) sector across the south of the UK, you will form part of a multi-disciplined team. The successful candidate will seek advice from SMEs to review and advise on the creation and verification of subsystem technical solutions lead the directly supporting the System Design Authority (SDA) in ensuring the system and sub system designs are:
- Fit for purpose and due consideration has been made for the integrity of the design
- Compliant with customer requirements and required standard
- Safety of the overall proposed architecture is maintained and assessed
As a result, strong technical, delivery, and people leadership skills and abilities are essential in this role, particularly the ability to discuss and resolve complex technical problems.
- Work closely with the SDA to identify and resolve technical issues across the whole system and subsystems and to ensure the integrity of the solution.
- Deputise for the SDA within the project.
- Lead the architecture team to develop and document the architecture thought the project lifecycle.
- Influence all levels of requirements to enable design and development decisions and trade-offs to be made.
- Provide direction, control, evaluation and recommendations relating to technical risks and opportunities.
- Support test planning and requirements verification to achieve certification and delivery for the overall system.
- Working with and influencing key project stakeholders including customer and end users.
- Present Architecture material at Design reviews internally and externally for the overall system.
- Act as a technical interface between the end customer and the Leonardo Engineering team.
- Actively support knowledge sharing and exploitation of best practice.
- Support the guidance and development of junior Engineers within the Engineering team.
- Contribute to the successful achievement of engineering.
- Support and advise sub-system design teams through their design reviews.
- Travel within the UK to meet with our customers and industry partners.

What you’ll bring
Required
- A degree (or equivalent experience) in a STEM subject and strong numerical, analytical and design skills, with the ability to apply these to real world problems.
- Strong understanding of system and project lifecycles as applicable to delivery of sub-systems, technical and commercial baselines, and change control.
- Strong understanding of Systems Architecture activities as part of the Systems Lifecycle.
- Self-motivated with a strong aptitude for problem-solving and decision-making within projects involving design complexity and uncertainty.
- Strong experience of influencing system design and integration of a major system.
- Strong experience in stakeholder management within organisations and with customers (internal or external) in a high-pressure environment, pulling in technical expertise when and where appropriate.
- Experience of successfully passing Design Reviews and implementing potentially complex remedial actions with sub-contract equipment suppliers and integration teams.
Ideally
- Knowledge of military Force Protection Electronic Counter Measures (FPECM) systems.
- Strong understanding of systems integration and progressive assurance.
- Experience of making design decisions by trading-off alternate solution based on functionality, performance and cost.
- Chartered engineer / member of the Institute of Engineering and Technology (IET)
This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.

postings.title: Network Engineer - NSX
postings.description:
Job Description:
Salary Range: £44,171 - £58,000
Leonardo UK operates a grade-based salary framework with broad bands. The salary range shown reflects the approved grade band for this role, or a narrower hiring range published within that band, and is benchmarked against the external market. Exceptions above the standard range are managed through governance controls to protect internal equity.

Your impact
Do you want to grow your career in network engineering and work on projects that safeguard the UK’s most critical systems? At Leonardo, our Network Engineers are at the heart of designing, configuring, and supporting secure networks that keep our customers connected and protected.

Your work at Leonardo UK will see you take the lead in solving customer problems in an agile, innovative and team-centric manner. The role may involve a blended hybrid working model, with a mixture of working from home and working on site at one of our Leonardo offices to ensure close collaboration with the wider team and with our customers.

What you will do as a Senior Network Engineer
- Design, configure, and support network virtualisation solutions (e.g. VMware NSX) within secure and enterprise environments

- Take ownership of engineering delivery for one or more work packages, including planning, estimation, execution, and reporting.

- Develop and review high- and low-level network designs and technical documentation.

- Integrate and test network components, ensuring compliance with performance and security requirements.

- Provide mentoring, guidance, and technical leadership to Network Engineers and Technicians.

- Collaborate with stakeholders, project teams, and customers to ensure solutions meet requirements.

- Drive continuous improvement and contribute to engineering standards and governance.

What you’ll bring
- Strong experience in designing, configuring, and supporting network virtualisation platforms (e.g. NSX or similar)

- Ability to balance hands-on engineering with technical leadership and mentoring responsibilities.

- Confidence to take ownership of solutions and represent networking in technical discussions.

Core areas (must have):
- Strong understanding of TCP/IP, OSI model, and routing/switching protocols (BGP, OSPF, QoS, VPNs, VLANs)

- Network virtualisation (NSX-T): design, configuration, and support of NSX-based networking environments

- Software-defined networking: implementation of logical switching, routing, and micro-segmentation

- Integration of NSX networking within virtualised and platform environments (e.g. VCF)

- Hands-on experience with Cisco or equivalent multi-vendor network equipment

- Network security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, segmentation)

- Familiarity with virtualisation and cloud networking concepts

- Network monitoring, diagnostic, and analytics tools

- Understanding of ITIL and service management frameworks

- Delivery within secure / enterprise / defence environments

Desirable:
- VMware NSX-T deep expertise and certification (or equivalent experience)

- VCF networking integration (vSphere, vSAN, Aria Suite)

- Overlay / underlay network design concepts

- Automation of network configuration (Ansible, Terraform, APIs)

- Integration with security tooling (SIEM, SOC platforms)

- Cloud networking (AWS, Azure) and hybrid connectivity

- Experience working in secure or regulated environments

This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.

Security Clearance
This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) will apply. This role requires Developed Vetting (DV) clearance prior to starting. For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting

Location
This role will be based at one of our UK sites - Yeovil.

Why join us
At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.
- Time to Recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year.

- Secure your Future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution.

- Your Wellbeing Matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity (Enable, Pride, Equalise, Armed Forces, Carers, Wellbeing and Ethnicity).

- Rewarding Performance: All employees at management level and below are eligible for our bonus scheme.

- Never Stop Learning: Free access to 4,000+ online courses via Coursera and LinkedIn Learning.

- Refer a friend: Receive a financial reward through our referral programme.

- Tailored Perks: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more.

- Flexible working: Flexible hours with hybrid working options. For part time opportunities, please talk to us about what might be possible for this role.

For a full list of our company benefits please visit our website.

Leonardo is a global leader in Aerospace, Defence, and Security. Headquartered in Italy, we employ over 53,000 people worldwide including 8,500 across 9 sites in the UK. Our employees are not just part of a team—they are key contributors to shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.
At Leonardo we are committed to building an inclusive, accessible, and welcoming workplace. We believe that a diverse workforce sparks creativity, drives innovation, and leads to better outcomes for our people and our customers. postings.title: Network Security Engineer
postings.description:
Job Description:
Who You Are
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Network Security Engineers to join our dynamic team and play a pivotal role in ensuring the security and integrity of our customer's network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of network security protocols, technologies, and best practices, along with a proven track record of designing, implementing, and maintaining robust security solutions. This role offers an exciting opportunity to lead and contribute to critical projects that safeguard our customer's network against emerging threats

What You Will Focus on
- Lead the design, implementation, and management of network security solutions to protect against unauthorized access, data breaches, and other cyber threats.
- Perform regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing to identify and address potential weaknesses in the network infrastructure.
- Develop and maintain firewall configurations, intrusion detection systems, and other security platforms to enhance network security posture
- Analyse network traffic for suspicious, and respond to security incidents in a timely and effective manner
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure security policies, standards, and procedures are followed throughout the organization.
- Stay updated with the latest security trends, vulnerabilities, and technologies to proactively address potential risks.
- Provide guidance and mentorship to junior security team members, sharing knowledge and best practices.
- Participate in incident response activities, including investigation, containment, and resolution of security incidents.
- Contribute to the development and implementation of disaster recovery and business continuity plans for network security.
- Participate in the evaluation and selection of third-party security solutions and vendors.

What You Bring
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Master's degree is a plus.
- Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in network security engineering, with a proven record of progressively responsible roles.
- Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCNP Security, or equivalent
- Extensive knowledge of network security protocols, encryption algorithms, and authentication mechanisms.
- Strong expertise in designing, implementing, and managing firewall technologies (e.g., Cisco ASA, Palo Alto).
- Proficiency in intrusion detection and prevention systems (IDS/IPS) and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solutions.
- Experience with network monitoring tools and packet analysis for identifying and mitigating security incidents.
- Deep understanding of cloud security principles and experience securing hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
- Familiarity with regulatory compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, NIST) and their impact on network security practices.

Essentially
- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically under pressure.
- Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Ability to work independently and lead security projects from inception to completion.
- Strong commitment to staying current with emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and industry trends.

Desirably
- Experience with identity and access management (IAM) projects
- Proven experience in scripting or programming languages for automating security tasks (e.g., Python, PowerShell)
- Demonstrated leadership skills and the ability to mentor and guide junior team members

postings.description:
Job Description:
Leonardo è un gruppo industriale internazionale, tra le principali realtà mondiali nell’Aerospazio, Difesa e Sicurezza che realizza capacità tecnologiche multidominio in ambito Elicotteri, Velivoli, Aerostrutture, Elettronica, Cyber Security e Spazio. Con oltre 60.000 dipendenti nel mondo, l’azienda ha una solida presenza industriale in Italia, Regno Unito, Polonia, Stati Uniti, e opera in 150 paesi anche attraverso aziende controllate, joint venture e partecipazioni. Protagonista dei principali programmi strategici a livello globale, è partner tecnologico e industriale di Governi, Amministrazioni della Difesa, Istituzioni e imprese.

Leonardo è uno dei partner industriali strategici del programma GCAP (Global Combat Air Programme), insieme alla britannica BAE Systems e alla giapponese Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, finalizzato allo sviluppo e alla realizzazione di un sistema aereo di nuova generazione, definito come “sistema di sistemi”. Impiegato per operazioni multidominio in ambito difesa, il sistema sarà caratterizzato da una “core platform” connessa con altri sistemi periferici “adjuncts”, pilotati e non pilotati.
Il programma, tra i più sfidanti e avveniristici per l’industria dell’aerospazio e della difesa, guiderà la rivoluzione tecnologica che caratterizzerà il settore nei prossimi cinquant’anni. Una sfida finalizzata a rafforzare la sovranità tecnologica e industriale dei paesi coinvolti, perché punta a identificare e a rendere disponibili quelle tecnologie innovative, dette abilitanti, che assicureranno il salto generazionale, generando ritorni positivi e progresso economico e sociale per l’intero sistema Paese, a beneficio delle nuove generazioni.
Le risorse che lavoreranno all’interno di questo programma avranno l’opportunità di accedere ad un percorso di crescita professionale in un contesto internazionale e tecnologicamente avanzato.
Nell’ambito della Joint Venture costituita per la realizzazione del Programma GCAP, ricerchiamo la figura di Personnel Security Operations Lead Specialist per il Quartier Generale GCAP sito a Reading (UK).
IL RUOLO PREVEDE UN PERIODO DI DISTACCO PRESSO IL SITO DI READING (UK) MINIMO DI 3 ANNI

OBIETTIVO DELL’INCARICO:
Il Personnel Security Operations Lead Specialist è una figura strategica responsabile della definizione, governance e supervisione del framework di sicurezza del personale dell’organizzazione. Il ruolo guida un team di tre specialisti tri-nazionali incaricati di garantire che tutte le persone con accesso a risorse umane, asset e informazioni dell’organizzazione soddisfino i più elevati standard di sicurezza.

In qualità di esperto di materia (Subject Matter Expert), il titolare della posizione guida l’implementazione delle policy di sicurezza del personale, assume decisioni complesse in ambito rischio e fornisce indirizzo autorevole agli stakeholder senior dell’organizzazione.

RESPONSABILITA’:
La risorsa farà parte della funzione di Operations per la JV e a diretto riporto dell’Interim HQ Operations Manager.

COMPITI:
Gestione del Team
- Responsabile della performance di un team di tre specialisti tri-nazionali in sicurezza del personale.

Leadership Strategica e Governance
- Guidare le operazioni di sicurezza del personale di Edgewing, assicurando l’allineamento con le policy aziendali in materia di Personnel Security, con il framework di gestione del rischio e con gli obiettivi organizzativi.

- Agire come riferimento senior per i processi di vetting, la mitigazione del rischio interno (insider risk) e la gestione delle autorizzazioni di sicurezza.

- Fornire consulenza specialistica a leadership esecutiva, HR, Legal e team operativi su casi di sicurezza del personale ad alto rischio o particolarmente sensibili.

- Supervisionare la conformità ai framework nazionali di sicurezza di UK/Italia/Giappone, ai requisiti regolatori (es. Industry Personnel Security Assurance – IPSA) e agli standard di settore.

Supervisione dei Processi di Vetting
- Dirigere e garantire la qualità di tutte le attività di vetting del personale, assicurando decisioni solide, coerenti e tempestive.

- Gestire casi di vetting complessi o in escalation, inclusi quelli con rischio elevato, ruoli sensibili o circostanze eccezionali.

- Costruire e mantenere relazioni solide con GIGO, enti governativi di vetting, agenzie esterne e partner chiave.

- In stretta collaborazione con i team di vetting delle società capogruppo (Parent Company), gestire i processi di verifica del personale, assicurando che i dipendenti distaccati presso Edgewing dispongano delle autorizzazioni di sicurezza necessarie prima dell’onboarding e per tutta la durata del distacco.

Gestione del Rischio e Minacce Interne
- Guidare i processi di valutazione del rischio in ambito sicurezza del personale, assicurando che i rischi siano identificati, analizzati e mitigati efficacemente.

- Supervisionare le attività di rilevazione e gestione del rischio interno (insider threat), in collaborazione con Security, HR e Legal.

- Fornire contributo senior alle indagini relative a violazioni della sicurezza del personale o a problematiche comportamentali.

Policy, Assurance e Miglioramento Continuo
- Essere responsabile della definizione e del continuo aggiornamento di standard e procedure in materia di sicurezza del personale, in coerenza con la Personnel Security Policy di Edgewing.

- Definire metriche di performance, meccanismi di assurance e framework di reporting per monitorare l’efficacia dei controlli di sicurezza del personale.

- Promuovere innovazione e miglioramento nei processi di vetting, nelle tecnologie e nei sistemi di gestione dei casi.

Coinvolgimento degli Stakeholder e Leadership
- Influenzare e sensibilizzare il senior management sui rischi, trend e best practice in materia di sicurezza del personale.

- Rappresentare l’organizzazione in forum intergovernativi o di settore, gruppi di lavoro e iniziative strategiche in ambito sicurezza.

- Fornire mentoring e supporto ai membri junior del team, promuovendo una cultura di professionalità ed elevate performance.

REQUISITI:

Titolo di studio: Diploma o qualifica equivalente in ambito sicurezza.

Conoscenze e Competenze Tecniche:
Requisiti essenziali:
- Esperienza significativa in ambito sicurezza del personale, operazioni di vetting o contesti di sicurezza nazionale.

- Approfondita conoscenza dei framework di clearance di sicurezza UK/Italia/Giappone (es. BPSS, SC, DV, PSC).

- Comprovata capacità di assumere decisioni complesse in ambito rischio e di fornire consulenza autorevole a livello senior.

- Solide competenze di leadership, stakeholder management e comunicazione.

- Capacità dimostrata di gestire informazioni sensibili con discrezione e integrità.

Requisiti preferenziali:
- Esperienza in contesti governativi, difesa, infrastrutture critiche nazionali o settori regolamentati.

- Conoscenza di programmi di insider risk e indicatori di rischio comportamentale.

- Familiarità con sistemi di case management o piattaforme di security vetting.

Competenze Trasversali (Soft Skills):
Requisiti essenziali:
- Solide competenze di stakeholder management, con esperienza di interazione trasversale tra diverse funzioni.

- Capacità decisionale pragmatica e orientata al business.

- Comprovate capacità di problem solving (pensiero analitico e laterale) su tematiche complesse.

- Capacità di costruire relazioni di fiducia a tutti i livelli dell’organizzazione.

- Buone capacità di comunicazione scritta, verbale e di presentazione.

- Attitudine al lavoro in team.

- Capacità di gestire in autonomia le proprie aree di responsabilità, con chiara consapevolezza del proprio perimetro decisionale.

Caratteristiche Personali:
- Visione strategica con capacità di bilanciare esigenze operative e obiettivi di sicurezza di lungo periodo.

- Sicurezza decisionale, in particolare in contesti ambigui o ad alta pressione.

- Elevata credibilità personale, con capacità di influenzare stakeholder senior e di fornire challenge costruttivo.

Job Description:
Salary Range: £50,000-£70,000

Leonardo UK operates a grade-based salary framework with broad bands. The salary range shown reflects the approved grade band for this role, or a narrower hiring range published within that band, and is benchmarked against the external market. Exceptions above the standard range are managed through governance controls to protect internal equity.

Your Impact
Leonardo UK is a global leader in aerospace, defence, and security technologies, delivering advanced capabilities across air, land, sea, cyber, and space domains. With major UK operations supporting radar, electronic warfare, and mission systems, Leonardo works in partnership with governments and industry to develop cutting-edge defence solutions that protect national security.
As part of our Integrated Planning team, we are seeking an Oracle Primavera P6 Technical Application Analyst to support the configuration of Oracle Primavera P6.
This role will involve working directly with the business and internal technical teams to deploy configurations, troubleshoot integration issues, and support the evolution of Leonardo’s Integrated Planning Solution.

What you'll do:
- Act as the technical authority for the Integrated Planning platforms, including Primavera P6, supporting application and integration tools, providing architectural oversight across application, infrastructure, and integration layers.
- Ensure applications are implemented and configured according to approved architecture and design standards.
- Review and sign off on as-built configurations, ensuring alignment with designed architecture and enterprise technology standards.
- Maintain ownership of application configuration management and technical platform integrity.
- Support the development of tactical solutions addressing Primavera P6 platform obsolescence.
- Contribute to the design and implementation of the strategic future-state roadmap for the IP platform.
- Evaluate opportunities to optimise or modernise the platform landscape supporting enterprise project controls.

What you'll bring:
- Strong technical expertise supporting Primavera P6 enterprise environments.
- Knowledge of P6 architecture, configuration, platform deployment, and lifecycle management.
- Experience supporting integrated project and portfolio management solutions or similar enterprise portfolio management platforms.
- Experience designing and supporting enterprise application architectures across application, database, and infrastructure layers.
- Knowledge of platform configuration management, system integration, and environment management.
- Experience supporting enterprise IT service management frameworks (incident, problem, change).
- Familiarity with technical governance, change management processes, and architecture documentation.
- Experience working in Agile delivery environments.

This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.

Security Clearance
This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV). For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting

- Flexible working: Flexible hours with hybrid working options. For part time opportunities, please talk to us about what might be possible for this role.

postings.title: Principal DevSECOps Engineer
postings.description:
Job Description:

The Leonardo Cyber Security Division is looking to recruit a Principal DevSecOp Engineer to join its UK based engineering team working within a highly secure environment; with responsibility for providing a bridge between software development, testing, infrastructure, operations and system administrators to facilitate efficient, continuous and high-quality software and environment delivery.

The processes and tooling implemented by the Principal DevSecOps Engineer will enable source code and associated artefacts to be installed and configured on scalable infrastructure across environments which comply to strict security regulations. The Principal DevSecOps Engineer will typically combine the skills of software coding and/or scripting, process reengineering and infrastructure provisioning with exemplary leadership, team working and communication skills. The Principal DevSecOps Engineer should have a good breadth of knowledge across the disciplines of software development and how software and infrastructure is deployed.

The ideal candidate will have demonstrable experience of performing in a similar strategic and leading DevSecOps position, and preferably working in a secure environment. You will possess a strong all round technical ability with an excellent working knowledge of platform capability area for Cloud / Hybrid and on-premise network and systems infrastructure technologies. An awareness of cyber security capabilities is advantageous. You will need to have strong experience in owning and overseeing the building, implementing and maintaining of systems with complex architectures on client site; with on-going proactive operational support, and working closely with key stakeholders and end users. Working within a specialist skilled engineering team providing 1st to 3rd line support to the client.

These roles demand excellent technical skills with the responsibility to support, maintain and operate systems while conforming to industry best practice and/or Leonardo best practices and technical designs. The principal role will require excellent leadership and team working attributes but also requires the ability to take accountability to work independently.

Projects will be from the full systems engineering lifecycle from Concept Exploration through to In-Service Support providing the opportunity to develop your experience while supporting the requirements management, system architecture and design, subsystem design and development, system integration, test and acceptance and specialist technical support.

What you’ll do as a Principal DevSecOps Engineer:
As a Principal DevSecOps Engineer within the Cyber Division, you will typically be working as part of a larger Project team including the design, development and testing of secure systems, including but not limited to, Information Management Systems, Command and Control systems, Security Monitoring of IT, IoT and CNI systems and services.

These roles will have the ability to take ownership / implement the DevSecOps side of the engineering delivery of one or more work packages, including the planning, estimation, execution and progress reporting of own workload and that of other team members.

What we need from you:
- Assist in the overall implementation of new software / applications / packing for the Cyber division.
- Analyse requirements, design, implement and unit test software code and supporting artefacts using appropriate tools.
- As required, lead on software/application development activities.
- Plan and undertake installations on development, test, reference and operational environments.
- Deliver consistent high-quality software and environmental builds through automation.
- Creation and maintenance of automaton frameworks for software and/or environment provisioning and ongoing operation.
- Managing and controlling software configuration for projects including the source repository.
- Implement and maintain of Continuous Integration (CI) and/or Build pipelines where appropriate.
- Understand change control and release management practices.
- Ensure high availability and security of systems through robust monitoring, logging, and alerting.
- Assist in data engineering activities (data cleansing, integration, onward data analytics).
- Provide application support to existing deployed services.
- Contribute to the improvement and efficiency of the Cyber division.

You really must have:
A good working knowledge and experience of various techniques with a broad scope of skills and experience of mainstream IT infrastructure services and components including:
- Demonstrable experience of performing a similar role, ideally within a secure or regulated environment.
- Lead the development and implementation of DevSecOps tools and practices.
- Support and mentor fellow DevSecOps engineers, fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture and driving continuous improvement to address operational issues.
- Advanced experience of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices and automation tools (Terraform & Ansible) for automating infrastructure builds and configuration.
- Strong experience of designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins) to automate builds, tests & deployments to ensure secure and compliant delivery of applications.
- Proficiency in managing Kubernetes clusters in a production setting, with a focus on security and scalability.
- Previous experience of developing and managing Helm charts for secure Kubernetes application deployments.
- Strong understanding of Git and Source Code Repository management (GitLab, GitHub); with experience of Branching Strategies for controlled Release Management.
- O/S System Administration experience - Linux, Windows level scripting.
- Good knowledge of Agile methodologies, SCRUM, BDD, TDD.
- Clear and effective communication skills.
- Strong analytical skills with an aptitude for solving complex/technical problems.
- Flexible and adaptable attitude, capable of acquiring new skills.
- Objective and logical with an enquiring and creative mind.

It would be nice if you had:
- Data Engineering – experience of one or more: Apache ecosystem, SQL, Python.
- Web - HTML, CSS, JavaScript, XML, SOAP.
- Experience with Secure DevSecOps within an Agile /SAFe environment.
- Containerisation & Orchestration - Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, Rancher etc.
- Software development capability. Any form of prior development expertise would be beneficial, but the eagerness and desire to learn new technologies would be preferable.

Security Clearance
You must be a sole UK National and hold current UK Developed Vetting (DV) security clearance.
For more information and guidance please visit : https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels

Life at Leonardo
With a company funded benefits package, a commitment to learning and development, and a flexible approach to working hours focused on the needs of both our employees and customers, a career with Leonardo has never offered as many opportunities or been more accessible to as many people.
- Pension: Award winning pension scheme (up to 10% employer contribution)
- Holidays: 25 days plus bank holidays, option to buy/sell leave and to accrue up to 12 additional flexi leave days per year
- Flexible Working: Flexible hours with hybrid working options. For part time opportunities, please talk to us
- Wellbeing: Employee Assistance Programme, access to Mental Health support, Financial wellbeing support, network groups (Enable, Pride, Equalise, Reservists, Carers)
- Lifestyle: Discounted Gym membership, Cycle to work scheme
- Company funded flexible benefits: Access to private healthcare, dental schemes, Workplace ISA, Go Green Car Scheme, technology and lifestyle options (£500 annual allowance)
- Training: Free access to more than 4000 online courses via Coursera
- Referral Incentive: You can earn a reward for successfully referring a friend or family member
- Bonus: Scheme in place for all employees at management level and below

For a full list of our Company benefits please visit our website.

This is a great opportunity to bring your talents and form an integral part of Leonardo’s future. We can help you develop your skills and offer great opportunities to develop and grow, so why not join us.

postings.description:
Job Description:
Do you want to grow your career in network engineering and work on projects that safeguard the UK’s national interests? At Leonardo, our Network Systems Engineers are at the heart of designing, configuring, and supporting secure networks that keep our customers connected and protected.
Your work at Leonardo UK will see you take the lead in meeting customer requirements. The role will involve a mixture of working from home and on site to ensure close collaboration with the wider team. When on site, this is an office- and integration laboratory-based role using network test equipment and a mix of commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) and military-off-the-shelf (MOTS) IP network and virtual environment technologies.

Your Impact
The successful candidate would provide technical expertise within the Land and Naval domain of Leonardo UK with a focus on IP network and virtual environment technologies for, predominantly, communications systems on naval platforms.
The successful candidate will be working within an Integrated Project Team and be responsible to the Project System Design Authority for the design, configuration, implementation, documentation, test and verification of resilient network and server data architectures within some of the most demanding naval environments across the whole product lifecycle.
The successful candidate would be expected to work towards Design Authority status for IP networks and virtual environments, providing technical governance over a system’s design, ensuring it is fit for purpose, compliant, architecturally coherent and controlled throughout its lifecycle.
Once deployed, the day-to-day support of the networks is generally performed by the customer, with Leonardo UK providing spare equipment and design authority support (such as obsolescence management and approval of configuration changes).
Key Responsibility Areas:
The successful candidate will work within the project engineering team and be responsible for:
· Architecting, designing and governing current and future naval communication network solutions and their implementation.
· Leading on network design including: production of high- and low-level network designs, development of logical and physical network architectures, definition of layer 2 and layer 3 architectures, production of routing, switching and segmentation strategies, allocation of communication services across network infrastructure.
· All assigned systems engineering aspects of new and existing networks and network applications embodied on naval platforms working at all phases of the development lifecycle.
· Defining network interfaces between communication systems, mission systems and other consumers.
· Support to the capture of design and test artefacts as appropriate for all stages in the engineering lifecycle appropriate for managing existing systems and for taking concepts through to development.
· Test definition, test execution and fault finding across IP networks and hosted systems.
· Development of system installation and setting to work guidance.
· Working closely with customers through the verification and validation stages of projects to ensure systems meet their requirements and needs.

Skills, Qualifications & Knowledge Required:
What you’ll bring
· Solid understanding of core networking concepts and protocols.
· Experience with configuring and supporting network devices in enterprise environments.
· Ability to work independently on defined work packages while collaborating effectively with wider teams.
· A proactive approach and willingness to learn new tools and technologies.
· Technical leadership within the scope of the system and its technology.
Core areas (must have):
· Practical experience of network implementation, setting to work and verification including interfacing communication systems, fault finding, fault resolution, electrical safety and safe working practices.
· Demonstrable experience in the design and implementation of network management architectures including monitoring, fault, configuration, performance management, capacity planning and integration of network management systems.
· Experience of writing documentation in support of the design, configuration, implementation and verification of a network, for user information and interface control.
· Hands on experience in COTS IP network equipment, particularly Cisco.
· Hands on experience in COTS virtual environment software.
· Hands on experience in COTS server software, for example Windows server and Active Directory, DNS, DHCP.
· Demonstrable experience as a COTS IP networks practitioner, equivalent to or higher than Cisco CCNA qualification.
· Experience of all engineering lifecycle phases.
· Knowledge of tools and processes used in the design, development and acceptance of products and systems.
· Knowledge of TCP/IP, OSPF, Multicast, the OSI model, and common networking protocols.
· Understanding of network security concepts and secure configurations with experience in designing secure network architectures and implementation of security controls to meet information assurance and cyber security requirements.
Desirable:
· Use of DOORS in requirements management.
· Experience in the use of Model Based Systems Engineering methodology.
· Experience in COTS virtual environment backup, network management and diagnostic software.
· Experience of communication system integration.
· Experience with user Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting (AAA) server software.
· Experience with Product Lifecycle Management tools, particularly Siemens Teamcenter.
This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skills are a good attitude and a willingness to learn

Leonardo is a global industrial group, among the main global players in Aerospace, Defence and Security that realises multi-domain technological capabilities in Helicopters, Aircraft, Aerostructures, Electronics, Cyber Security and Space. A key player in major international strategic programmes, it is a technological and industrial partner of governments, defence administrations, institutions and companies.

Within the GCAP Joint Venture, in the GCAP Finance UO, we are looking for a Rates Analyst for GCAP HQ in Reading (UK).

The Rates Analyst will play an important role in the Finance Team of the GCAP Joint Venture, joining right at the start of its journey. This is a rare, once in a generation opportunity to have exposure to a wide range of tasks and stakeholders at the inception of a new company, supporting the creation of enduring cost centre and labour rate structures and monitoring the cost performance of the JV during a critical time in the early lifecycle of the JV.

The role will join the organisation as the labour rates approach starts taking shape and will therefore need to demonstrate remarkable adaptability and ability to future-proof analysis and reporting frameworks, leveraging modern systems and processes.

This is a rare opportunity to influence the future of a new International Joint Venture. The role is working within a multi-national team and will offer a varied workload which will provide an excellent opportunity to develop unique skills and will need a candidate who is able to adapt to a changing environment.
Due to the fast-moving nature of the new company, the role is expected to offer a varied workload which will offer the opportunity to reach outside of the finance function. This will provide an excellent environment to develop skills and will need a candidate who is able to adapt to a changing environment.

Accountabilities

- Analyse Edgewing organisation and activities (Headquarter and NATCOs) to understand operative costs and cost drivers, in collaboration with the Cost Base analyst.

- Define the principles underlying labour rates through Edgewing organization, provide simulations with evaluation of the impacts, and periodically agree the mechanism withing Edgewing and GCAP Agency

- Produce on a monthly basis the under/over recovery analysis (actuals vs budget/forecast) to understand key drivers for efficiency and performance of the business, including a focus on throughput and utilisation metrics

- Support performance optimisation and decision-making, producing regular as well as ad-hoc reporting to be presented to Senior budget holders

- Support price investigation through specific expertise on the organisation’s cost structure

- Support the delivery of optimisation initiatives for the business through ad-hoc pieces of work as required

Essential Qualifications
- Relevant financial qualification (or studying towards it,);

- Strong academic background and track record

Skilss and Experience
- Experience of cost and management accounting;

- Good understanding of the key drivers of organisational efficiency;

- Ability to collaborate with stakeholders of various seniorities and backgrounds, relaying financial concepts in a simple and understandable manner;

- Problem solving mentality and ability to work in a fast-moving and dynamic environment.

postings.description:
Job Description:
Your impact
Leonardo is seeking an experienced Red Team Consultant to join our growing Offensive Security capability. This role is open to both Senior and Principal level Consultants.
Working within a defence-focused environment, you will deliver threat-led security assessments, adversary emulation activities and advanced security testing for customers operating within complex and high-assurance environments. You will emulate realistic cyber threats, assess the effectiveness of security controls and provide actionable recommendations to help customers strengthen their resilience against sophisticated adversaries.
This role offers the opportunity to be more than a delivery consultant. As one of the key technical members of a growing Red Team capability, you will play an important role in shaping how the service develops. Alongside customer engagements, you will contribute to the evolution of our tooling, methodologies, technical approaches and service offerings, helping establish the foundations for a scalable and highly capable Red Team practice.
You will work closely with cyber security specialists across Leonardo, providing technical input into delivery, capability development and innovation activities. The role combines hands-on offensive security work with research, experimentation and continuous improvement, providing opportunities to broaden your expertise while contributing to the growth of the wider team. We are looking for someone who is passionate about offensive security, enjoys solving challenging technical problems and is motivated by the opportunity to help build something for the future. The successful candidate will become an integral part of Leonardo's offensive security capability, helping to influence its direction while delivering meaningful outcomes for our customers.

What you’ll do as Red Team Consultant
- Deliver Red Team and Adversary Simulation Activities
Deliver threat-led security assessments, adversary emulation and red team activities within complex defence and government environments. You will work as part of the Leonardo’s delivery teams to ensure the effectiveness of people, processes and technology against realistic cyber threats, producing clear findings and recommendations that improve customer resilience.
- Support Red Team Capability Development
Contribute to the ongoing development of Leonardo's growing Red Team capability. You will help shape tooling, methodologies, operational processes and best practices, ensuring services continue to evolve in line with emerging threats, customer requirements and industry standards.
- Research and Innovation
Conduct research into emerging threat actor tactics, techniques and procedures (TTPs), offensive security tooling and adversary simulation approaches. Apply this knowledge to continuously improve technical capability and bring new ideas into customer engagements.
- Operational Infrastructure and Tooling
Support the design, provisioning and maintenance of infrastructure used during red team and adversary simulation activities. This includes the deployment and management of security tooling, cloud-based environments and supporting platforms required to conduct operations safely and effectively.
- Documentation and Knowledge Sharing
Produce high-quality technical documentation, reports and operational procedures. Share knowledge across the wider team through mentoring, collaboration and technical discussions to help strengthen Leonardo's offensive security capability.
- Customer and Stakeholder Engagement
Work closely with customers, project teams and security stakeholders to scope activities, communicate findings and support the successful delivery of engagements. You will contribute technical expertise throughout the engagement lifecycle, from planning through to final reporting and replay activities.
- Core Consulting Skills
Building client relations; adaptability to changing schedules; reliability and quality of task delivery; flexibility in working hours and locations; team player.

You will have access to dedicated training and professional development opportunities, including support towards industry-recognised certifications, specialised technical training, conferences and research activities.
- Capability Growth: This role provides a unique opportunity to develop both technical and leadership skills. You will work alongside experienced cyber security professionals while helping shape a growing red team service, gaining exposure to capability development, service innovation and technical leadership activities.
- Research and Innovation Time: We encourage continuous learning and provide opportunities to explore new tooling, attacker techniques, research areas and emerging technologies that can be incorporated into customer engagements and future service offerings.

What you’ll bring
We are looking for a motivated and self-driven individual who is passionate about offensive security and enjoys solving complex technical challenges. You will be comfortable working independently, collaborating with customers and colleagues, and contributing to the growth of a developing capability. This role would suit someone who enjoys hands-on red teaming while also wanting to influence how a capability develops and matures over time.

Core areas (must have):
- Experience delivering red team, adversary simulation or advanced penetration testing activities.
- Relevant certifications relating to red teaming.
- Strong technical skills in one or more of the following areas: initial access, cloud exploitation, malware development, detection evasion, operational security, physical security testing or adversary emulation.
- Experience using scripting or development languages such as Python, C#, JavaScript, Go, Rust or similar.
- Ability to contribute technical leadership and provide direction during engagements.
- Strong analytical, communication and reporting skills.
- Willingness to travel to customer sites, generally Bristol and SW.
- Is comfortable with suitable coding languages for OST / Malware development (C, C#, Python, JS, Go, Rust).
- Ability to attain DV clearance and hold sole UK nationality, no sponsorship available for this role.
Desirable
- Experience working within Defence, MOD or other high-assurance environments.
- Understanding of frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, CAF or NIST.
- Experience designing or maintaining infrastructure used to support offensive security operations.
- Experience developing tools, automation or bespoke offensive security capabilities.
